findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_epistemic_isotopes · Private data: verify_upstream_provenance, sign_clearing_guestbook, inspect_svg_multimodal_surface, analyze_router_bode_response, audit_brand_impersonation_signal, transmit_lantern_reply, inspect_key_laundry_burst · Public sink: inspect_inbound_email_headers, answer_lantern_layer · Destructive: get_epistemic_isotope, audit_isotope_rag_fidelity, export_blue_team_detections.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_epistemic_isotopes · Private data: verify_upstream_provenance, sign_clearing_guestbook, inspect_svg_multimodal_surface, analyze_router_bode_response, audit_brand_impersonation_signal, transmit_lantern_reply, inspect_key_laundry_burst · Public sink: inspect_inbound_email_headers, answer_lantern_layer · Destructive: get_epistemic_isotope, audit_isotope_rag_fidelity, export_blue_team_detections

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
